scope: Independent review of parent-authored transfer integration, separately authored measurement harness, and Python reference extraction/qualification. This is source/qualification review, not a performance result or final pipeline audit.

independence_exclusion.reason: Reviewer authored the engine and size preflight. Independent engine review belongs to selector_tests; no self-approval is claimed here.

resolved_findings.issue: Cold-start comparison could charge unnecessary checkpoint seeds to raw/zstd baselines.
resolved_findings.resolution: Contract now distinguishes equal-setup measured totals from practical runtime(seed+target) versus raw/zstd(target-only); adaptive checkpoint seed remains required.

resolved_findings.issue: Fixture generation could be mistaken for unavoidable existing-file transfer cost.
resolved_findings.resolution: Contract identifies generation as workload construction and permits application-to-ack composition only for an application that actually generates its data this way.

resolved_findings.issue: Python oracle reproduction depends on originals outside a fresh clone.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reference README explicitly states non-self-contained Python reproduction and pinned local source dependency. Originals remain local under the publication boundary; bundled excerpts/vectors and Rust tests are portable and inspectable.

verified_properties: Runtime checkpoint lookup and all request handling use the existing authenticated context namespace and authority checks.
Replay resource reservation precedes generation; setup produces Accepted(0) and does not acknowledge object publication.
Prediction digest/length are checked before replacement of the residual base; final target length/digest, authorization recheck, and durable publication remain mandatory.
Missing checkpoint and malformed/digest failures propagate; there is no implicit network retry or cross-namespace fallback.
Runtime candidate is considered after existing candidates, uses exact complete HTTP-body cost, and loses equal-cost ties.
Local harness serializes actual protocol batches and adds the exact 16-byte receiver metric envelope difference; values are labeled HTTP-body-equivalent, not network wire bytes.
Remote body counts exclude HTTP/TLS/IP/retransmission overhead; remote receiver CPU is a handler subtotal, not total remote host CPU.
Local operation CPU already contains receiver work; exchange and receiver timers are nested and must not be added again.
Successful local transfers close/reopen the store and compare every byte before owned cache cleanup; remote acknowledgements remain explicitly pending stopped-receiver exact verification.
Plan/config/fixture/source/executable identities, fresh scopes, create_new evidence, failed-operation rows, and final completion rows support later independent audit.
Python generator checks pinned source hashes before selected-AST compilation and excludes original startup, saved cards, router/audio, network, and wall-clock execution.

observed_checks.result: 8/8 independent Python oracle qualification tests; executed by this reviewer
Actual successful all-target Cargo check output inspected; command executed by selector_tests
Actual successful all-target Clippy output inspected; command executed by selector_tests
22/22 engine tests executed by this reviewer as implementer, not independent engine approval; native golden bytes unchanged

limitations: Current qualified target is native 64-bit aarch64-apple-darwin; no wasm/32-bit or cross-architecture runtime qualification is claimed.
Pure byte-on-line time, complete network wire bytes, energy, and total remote/relay CPU are not measured by this harness.
Generated traces are favorable shared-state workloads; unrelated controls and losing candidate computation must remain in reports.
Operator-provided revision and remote executable identifiers require retained build/source custody evidence; source hashes alone do not prove a clean checkout.
No new local acceptance campaign or WAN performance conclusion is asserted by this review.
prerequisites_before_timing: Parent completes and retains frozen release qualification and executable/source identity.
Any changed reviewed source receives a scoped review update.
No builds, tests, profilers, or other measurement jobs run during timed trials.
